units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 18:1">Targ. Y. Gen. XVIII, 1</cite> <he>מ׳ מִכֵּיבָא וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="M01380"><he>מַכִּי׳</he></cite>) suffering from the wound &c.; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 34:6">Targ. Y. I Deut. XXXIV, 6</cite> <he>מ׳ מִגְּזֵרַת וכ׳</he>.
Targ. O. Gen. XLVIII, 1 מְרָע ed. Berl. (oth. ed. a. Y. שכיב מ׳); a. fr.—Esp. (in Talm. also in Hebr. dict.) שכיב מ׳ dangerously ill, expected to die.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 19:14">Targ. I Sam. XIX, 14</cite> (v. <cite ref="M02729">preced.</cite>).—

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 9:6">B. Bath. IX, 6</cite> <he>שכיב מ׳ שכתב וכ׳</he> if a sick man assigns all of his property to a stranger (as an unqualified donation, v. <cite ref="M03089"><he>מַתָּנָה</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 9:6">Ib.</cite> <he>לא כתב בה ש׳ מ׳</he> if it was not stated in the document that he was sick; <he>הוא אומר ש׳ מ׳ היה</he> he (the donor) says that he was sick (at the time), opp. <he>בריא</he>. Ib. 152ᵃ, a. fr. <he>מתנת ש׳ מ׳</he> the donation of a sick man; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>מַרְעִין</he>, <he>מַרְעַיָּא</he>. Targ. Y. I Deut. l. c.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 126:1">Targ. Ps. CXXVI, 1</cite> <he>היך מ׳ וכ׳</he> like the sick when recovering (h. text <he>כחלמים</he>, v. <cite ref="H01081"><he>חָלַם</he> I</cite>).
Targ. Ez. XXXIV, 4; a. e.; v. מְרִיעַ.—Fem. מַרְעָא, מְרַעֲתָא, מְרָעיתָא.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 69:21">Targ. Ps. LXIX, 21</cite> <he>והא היא מרעא</he> ed. Lag. (Var. <cite ref="M00571"><he>מוצא</he></cite>, cler. error; ed. Wil. <he>והא היא תקיפא</he>; h. text <he>וָאָנוּשָׁה</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 2:5">Targ. Cant. II, 5</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 5:8">Ib. V, 8</cite>.
